text: As a fresh wound shrinks back from the hand of the surgeon, but by degrees submits to, and even seeks of its own accord the means of its cure, so a mind under the first impression of a misfortune shuns and rejects all consolations, but at length desires and is lulled by their gentle application.
author: Pliny the Younger
translation: William Melmoth, rev. F. C. T. Bosanquet
